name: Disneyland Carnation Cafe Walt's Favorite Beef Meatloaf & Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: Ground beef and pork meatloaf baked tender with mild seasonings, served with fluffy mashed potatoes and savory brown gravy. Soft texture requires minimal mechanical breakdown.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Walt's Meatloaf with mashed potatoes and light brown gravy (ask for steamed carrots instead of seasoned vegetables).
